name: dashboard-01
title: Dashboard 01
description: A complete dark admin screen: an inset sidebar with search and grouped links, four metric cards, a visitors area chart with range toggles, and a data table with tabs, editable cells and row controls.
use: You need a ready-made analytics app shell with navigation, KPIs, a traffic chart and a task table in one screen.
avoid: It is heavy and pulls in many shared UI pieces; a single chart or a lone table is far lighter.
a11y: Most controls are labelled and keyboard reachable, but the area chart has no text alternative, and nothing checks prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark two-panel app shell: a rounded sidebar holds a logo, search box, grouped nav links and a user footer; the wider rounded main panel shows a Documents header, four metric cards in a 2x2 grid, a grey area chart with three range toggles and a many-column data table.
behaves: Switching a chart range redraws the shaded grey area. In the table, tabs swap datasets, headers sort rows, a grip drags rows to reorder, checkboxes select them, and the Target and Limit numbers can be edited inline, firing a saving toast.
customise: Nav items, chart data and table rows live in hardcoded arrays in the companion files; the sidebar variant is the main prop and nearly everything else needs a source edit.
weight: moderate: Whole app screen with sidebar, an SVG chart and a large table plus many shared UI dependencies.
demo: Revenue $1,250, 1,234 new customers, 45,678 accounts, a Total Visitors chart and rows like Cover page.
issues: The Reviewer column is cut off at the right edge of the table in the frames.
Editable Target and Limit cells look like plain numbers, so the inputs are easy to miss.
polishWhy: Polished, consistent app screen; minor table clipping and a very low-contrast chart.
